moc.chu: The aim of the expeditions was to measure the gravitational deflection of starlight passing near the Sun.
Eddington sailed from England in March 1919.
On April 30 the team arrived at Sobral.
The eclipse was due to take place in the early afternoon of 29 May, at 2 pm, but that morning there was a storm with heavy rain.
The results were announced at a joint meeting of the Royal Society and Royal Astronomical Society in November 1919
